sahneler.anlatim: Phantom Blade Zero's 1.0304629 patch is out, and camera assist gets a new setting.
According to Steam's official patch notes, the update is 7 GB on PC, and players should remove third-party mods before installing.

veri.alinti: Patch download size is 7 GB; remove third-party mods before updating.

sahneler.anlatim: A new Combat Assist section lands in Settings. With Automatic Strong Camera Assist off, strong camera help only applies while you attack an enemy. Mouse players also get a target-switch sensitivity setting, and 0 turns mouse switching off.

maddeler.metin: Strong camera help only while attacking
Mouse target-switch sensitivity; 0 turns it off
